title: Why keep a public project journal?
summary: An introduction to this portfolio: a place to collect updates, document decisions and make space for new ideas.
body:
Projects change as you work on them. Decisions that seem obvious today often become difficult to reconstruct later. A project journal gives those decisions a home.

## What belongs here

- Work in progress and release notes
- Screenshots, concepts and experiments
- Lessons learned from successful and unsuccessful attempts

These demonstration articles are editable from Pages CMS, including headings and uploaded images.
